dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gas light just came on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡæs laɪt dʒʌst keɪm ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 油量警示燈剛剛亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the tank is almost empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ðə tæŋk ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst ˈɛmti./
dialogue.zh: 那就表示油箱快見底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a gas station nearby?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ɡæs ˈsteɪʃən ˌnɪrˈbaɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 附近有加油站嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there is one right around the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛr ɪz wʌn raɪt əˈraʊnd ðə ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 有，就在拐角那兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's stop here before dinner.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts stɑp hɪr bɪˈfɔr ˈdɪnər./
dialogue.zh: 我們晚飯前先在這兒停一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, we need a full tank.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, wi nid ə fʊl tæŋk./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我們需要把油加滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my card for gas?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid maɪ kɑrd fər ɡæs?/
dialogue.zh: 加油一定要用卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, or you can pay with cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɔr ju kæn peɪ wɪð kæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 對，也可以付現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the price sign says three thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə praɪs saɪn sɛz θri ˈθɜrdi./
dialogue.zh: 看，價格牌上寫著三塊三。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is cheaper than the last station.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈtʃipər ðən ðə læst ˈsteɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 比上次那家加油站便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which pump should we use?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ pʌmp ʃʊd wi juz?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該用哪台加油機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pump twelve is free over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʌmp twɛlv ɪz fri ˈoʊvər ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那邊十二號機空著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is pump twelve working today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz pʌmp twɛlv ˈwɜrkɪŋ təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 十二號機今天能用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think so, the screen is on.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk soʊ, ðə skrin ɪz ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 應該可以，螢幕亮著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which side is the gas door on?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ saɪd ɪz ðə ɡæs dɔr ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 加油口在哪一側？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the arrow next to your fuel gauge.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ði ˈæroʊ ˈnɛkst tə jʊr ˈfjuəl ɡeɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 看油表旁邊的箭頭指哪邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I open this little door?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ˈoʊpən ðɪs ˈlɪtəl dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 這個小門要怎麼打開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the lever by the driver seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðə ˈlivər baɪ ðə ˈdraɪvər sit./
dialogue.zh: 拉一下駕駛座旁邊的拉桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This door feels stuck a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs dɔr filz stʌk ə ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 這門有點卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it gently and it will pop.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ɪt ˈdʒɛntli ænd ɪt wɪl pɑp./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕推一下就彈開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I keep the gas cap?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ kip ðə ɡæs kæp?/
dialogue.zh: 油箱蓋該放哪兒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hangs right there on the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæŋz raɪt ðɛr ɑn ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 它就掛在小門內側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I turn the cap to the left?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ tɜrn ðə kæp tə ðə lɛft?/
dialogue.zh: 油箱蓋要往左擰嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, left to loosen, right to close.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, lɛft tə ˈlusən, raɪt tə kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 對，左擰鬆、右擰緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I shut off the engine first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ʃʌt ˈɔf ði ˈɛndʒən fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 要先熄火嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is a safety rule here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt ɪz ə ˈseɪfti rul hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 要，這裡是安全規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to leave the car running?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ tə liv ðə kɑr ˈrʌnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 發動機不關可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, please turn it off now.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, pliz tɜrn ɪt ˈɔf naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不行，請現在熄火。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What gas does this car need?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɡæs dʌz ðɪs kɑr nid?/
dialogue.zh: 這輛車要加什麼油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Regular is fine, it saves money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛɡjələr ɪz faɪn, ɪt seɪvz ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 普通油就夠了，還省錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is regular the cheapest one here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈrɛɡjələr ðə ˈtʃipɪst wʌn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 普通油是這裡最便宜的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is the eighty seven grade.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ɪz ði ˈeɪti ˈsɛvən ɡreɪd./
dialogue.zh: 對，就是八十七號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the plus grade for?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə plʌs ɡreɪd fər?/
dialogue.zh: 中階油是做什麼用的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sporty cars often want mid gas.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspɔrti kɑrz ˈɔfən wɑnt mɪd ɡæs./
dialogue.zh: 有些跑車會要用中階油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I ever need premium fuel?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ˈɛvər nid ˈprimiəm ˈfjuəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我用得著高級油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not for this car, save your money.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt fər ðɪs kɑr, seɪv jʊr ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 這車用不上，省點錢吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen shows four fuel choices.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin ʃoʊz fɔr ˈfjuəl ˈtʃɔɪsəz./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上有四種油可選。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press regular, then press start there.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ˈrɛɡjələr, ðɛn prɛs stɑrt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 先按普通油，再按開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I set the dollar amount?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɛt ðə ˈdɑlər əˈmaʊnt?/
dialogue.zh: 我能設定加油金額嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, by dollars or by gallons.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, baɪ ˈdɑlərz ɔr baɪ ˈɡælənz./
dialogue.zh: 可以，按金額或按加侖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's just fill the whole tank.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts dʒʌst fɪl ðə hoʊl tæŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我們乾脆加滿一箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pick the full tank option.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pɪk ðə fʊl tæŋk ˈɑpʃən./
dialogue.zh: 那就選加滿那一檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a full tank here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ə fʊl tæŋk hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡加滿要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe forty dollars, the tank is big.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz, ðə tæŋk ɪz bɪɡ./
dialogue.zh: 大概四十塊，油箱挺大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, is this pump diesel or gas?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn, ɪz ðɪs pʌmp ˈdizəl ɔr ɡæs?/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，這台是柴油還是汽油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Diesel only, the nozzle is black.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdizəl ˈoʊnli, ðə ˈnoʊzəl ɪz blæk./
dialogue.zh: 只有柴油，油槍是黑色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I almost put diesel in my car!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlmoʊst pʊt ˈdizəl ɪn maɪ kɑr!/
dialogue.zh: 我差點把柴油加進汽油車！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky you looked, diesel guns are bigger.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ju lʊkt, ˈdizəl ɡʌnz ɑr ˈbɪɡər./
dialogue.zh: 幸好你看了，柴油槍口更大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So who fills up at the diesel pump?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hu fɪlz ʌp æt ðə ˈdizəl pʌmp?/
dialogue.zh: 那誰會在柴油那台機加油呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big trucks and vans, they wait out back.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ trʌks ænd vænz, ðeɪ weɪt aʊt bæk./
dialogue.zh: 大卡車和廂型車，都在後面等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I found the right pump now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ faʊnd ðə raɪt pʌmp naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我找到對的那台了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, lift the nozzle out slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, lɪft ðə ˈnoʊzəl aʊt ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 很好，慢慢把油槍提出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This nozzle feels really heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈnoʊzəl filz ˈrɪəli ˈhɛvi./
dialogue.zh: 這把油槍真的好沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it with both hands if needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt wɪð boʊθ hændz ɪf ˈnidəd./
dialogue.zh: 需要就兩隻手一起拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly does the nozzle go?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪɡˈzæktli dʌz ðə ˈnoʊzəl ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 油槍到底要插到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it deep into the tank hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ɪt dip ˈɪntə ðə tæŋk hoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 插進油箱口裡面去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I start pumping before I pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ stɑrt ˈpʌmpɪŋ bɪˈfɔr aɪ peɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 可以先加油再付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap your card at the pump.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tæp jʊr kɑrd æt ðə pʌmp./
dialogue.zh: 可以，在機器上拍一下卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card did not work at first.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd dɪd nɑt wɜrk æt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我的卡一開始沒刷上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the little keypad once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈkiˌpæd wʌns mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 再試一次小鍵盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks me for my zip code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æsks mi fər maɪ zɪp koʊd./
dialogue.zh: 它問我郵遞區號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enter the five digits of your zip code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛntər ðə faɪv ˈdɪdʒɪts ʌv jʊr zɪp koʊd./
dialogue.zh: 輸入你郵遞區號的五位數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it says press enter here.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt sɛz prɛs ˈɛntər hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 現在它提示我在這裡按確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it, and the pump gets ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɪt, ænd ðə pʌmp ɡɛts ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 按下去，加油機就待命了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the power on for this pump?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈpaʊər ɑn fər ðɪs pʌmp?/
dialogue.zh: 這台加油機通電了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, squeeze the handle to begin.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, skwiz ðə ˈhændəl tə bɪˈɡɪn./
dialogue.zh: 通了，握緊把手就開始出油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is no lock on this handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ lɑk ɑn ðɪs ˈhændəl./
dialogue.zh: 這個把手上沒有卡扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then hold it the whole time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hoʊld ɪt ðə hoʊl taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那就從頭到尾握緊吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gas is going in so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡæs ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɪn soʊ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 油進得特別快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wide new hose does that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə waɪd nju hoʊz dʌz ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 新管子粗，流速就大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You always fill up on Fridays, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɔlweɪz fɪl ʌp ɑn ˈfraɪdeɪz, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你總是在週五把油加滿，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my tank never drops below half.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, maɪ tæŋk ˈnɛvər drɑps bɪˈloʊ hæf./
dialogue.zh: 對，我油箱從不低於一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wait until the light comes on.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ weɪt ʌnˈtɪl ðə laɪt kʌmz ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 我總等警示燈亮才加油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try not to run it that low.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ nɑt tə rʌn ɪt ðæt loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 別把油跑到那麼空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does blended fuel hurt my engine?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ˈblɛndəd ˈfjuəl hɜrt maɪ ˈɛndʒən?/
dialogue.zh: 混合油會傷發動機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, most cars handle it just fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, moʊst kɑrz ˈhændəl ɪt dʒʌst faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 不會，大多數車都沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is this grade called eight nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðɪs ɡreɪd kɔld eɪt naɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼這檔油叫八九號？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The number shows its octane rating.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnʌmbər ʃoʊz ɪts ˈɑkˌteɪn ˈreɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那個數字是辛烷值等級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I get the car washed too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ɡɛt ðə kɑr wɑʃt tu?/
dialogue.zh: 順便洗個車怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wash machine takes only coins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɑʃ məˈʃin teɪks ˈoʊnli kɔɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 洗車機只收硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any water bottles for sale here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈwɔtər ˈbɑtəlz fər seɪl hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這兒賣瓶裝水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, inside the store near the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɪnsaɪd ðə stɔr nɪr ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有，就在店裡門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, that coffee machine in the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðæt ˈkɔfi məˈʃin ɪn ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 你看，店裡面那台咖啡機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine runs all day long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin rʌnz ɔl deɪ lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那台機器整天都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, where is the trash bin?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ, wɛr ɪz ðə træʃ bɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 請問垃圾桶在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stands by the store entrance.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stændz baɪ ðə stɔr ˈɛntrəns./
dialogue.zh: 就在商店門口旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it safe to use my phone here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt seɪf tə juz maɪ foʊn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 在這兒用手機安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better keep it inside while you pump.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər kip ɪt ˈɪnsaɪd waɪl ju pʌmp./
dialogue.zh: 加油時最好先收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My kid keeps asking how long it takes.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɪd kips ˈæskɪŋ haʊ lɔŋ ɪt teɪks./
dialogue.zh: 我家孩子一直問要多久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him about five minutes at most.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm əˈbaʊt faɪv ˈmɪnəts æt moʊst./
dialogue.zh: 告訴他最多五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See that car waiting for our pump?
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðæt kɑr ˈweɪtɪŋ fər ˈaʊər pʌmp?/
dialogue.zh: 你看，有車在等我們這台機子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are almost done, wave them over.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr ˈɔlmoʊst dʌn, weɪv ðɛm ˈoʊvər./
dialogue.zh: 快加完了，揮手請他們過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who parks way over in that back row?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu pɑrks weɪ ˈoʊvər ɪn ðæt bæk roʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 停在後面那一排的是哪些車呀？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly the trucks, the diesel lane is there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ðə trʌks, ðə ˈdizəl leɪn ɪz ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 多數是卡車，柴油車道在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This station looks cleaner than most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈsteɪʃən lʊks ˈklinər ðən moʊst./
dialogue.zh: 這座站比別家乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The owner takes real pride in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈoʊnər teɪks riəl praɪd ɪn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 老闆經營得很用心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I supposed to stay right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ səˈpoʊzd tə steɪ raɪt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我必須一直留在這兒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, never walk away during pumping.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈnɛvər wɔk əˈweɪ ˈdʊrɪŋ ˈpʌmpɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 對，加油時別走開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I am right here holding it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ æm raɪt hɪr ˈhoʊldɪŋ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好的，我就在這裡握著油槍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, keep it deep and steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, kip ɪt dip ænd ˈstɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 很好，插深、拿穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Squeeze the handle and gas flows out.
dialogue.phonetic: /skwiz ðə ˈhændəl ænd ɡæs floʊz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 握緊把手，油就流出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the numbers climb on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə ˈnʌmbərz klaɪm ɑn ðə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 看著螢幕上的數字往上漲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the gallons are rising right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /si, ðə ˈɡælənz ɑr ˈraɪzɪŋ raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你看，加侖數正在往上漲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So is the cost, little by little.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪz ðə kɔst, ˈlɪtəl baɪ ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 價錢也在一點點增加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we still under forty dollars?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi stɪl ˈʌndər ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz?/
dialogue.zh: 油錢還不到四十塊吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is still climbing slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ɪz stɪl ˈklaɪmɪŋ ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 對，數字還在慢慢往上爬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, we are past ten gallons.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, wi ɑr pæst tɛn ˈɡælənz./
dialogue.zh: 你看，已經超過十加侖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon that soft click will come.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun ðæt sɑft klɪk wɪl kʌm./
dialogue.zh: 很快那聲輕咔噠就會來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pump is slower than the last.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pʌmp ɪz ˈsloʊər ðən ðə læst./
dialogue.zh: 這台比上次那台慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old pumps take their time, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld pʌmps teɪk ðɛr taɪm, ˈsædli./
dialogue.zh: 老舊的加油機就是磨蹭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not pull the nozzle out yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt pʊl ðə ˈnoʊzəl aʊt jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 先別把油槍拔出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, it stays inside while filling.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ, ɪt steɪz ˈɪnsaɪd waɪl ˈfɪlɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我知道，加的時候不能離開口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, did the pump just click off?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, dɪd ðə pʌmp dʒʌst klɪk ˈɔf?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，加油機剛咔噠跳槍了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that click means the tank is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt klɪk minz ðə tæŋk ɪz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 對，那一響就是加滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, I wanted a little more gas.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl, aɪ ˈwɑntɪd ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr ɡæs./
dialogue.zh: 可我還是想再多加一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep topping till it clicks again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kip ˈtɑpɪŋ tɪl ɪt klɪks əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就再補，直到又跳槍為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I squeeze once after the click?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ skwiz wʌns ˈæftər ðə klɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 跳槍之後還能再握一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You topped it, that is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tɑpt ɪt, ðæt ɪz ˈplɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 你已經補好了，這樣就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why keep pumping after it stops?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ kip ˈpʌmpɪŋ ˈæftər ɪt stɑps?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼跳槍了還硬要加？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gentle squeezes can spill fresh gas.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛntəl ˈskwɪzəz kæn spɪl frɛʃ ɡæs./
dialogue.zh: 多壓那幾下會溢出新油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Air gets pushed out as the tank fills.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛr ɡɛts pʊʃt aʊt æz ðə tæŋk fɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 油箱邊進油邊把空氣排出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hear that hissing? It is totally normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðæt ˈhəsɪŋ? ɪt ɪz ˈtoʊtəli ˈnɔrməl./
dialogue.zh: 聽見那嘶嘶聲了嗎？完全正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the nozzle stop by itself?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðə ˈnoʊzəl stɑp baɪ ɪtˈsɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 油槍為什麼會自己停下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tiny sensor feels the fuel rise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaɪni ˈsɛnsər filz ðə ˈfjuəl raɪz./
dialogue.zh: 小感應器感覺到油麵上升。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, some drops fell on the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, sʌm drɑps fɛl ɑn ðə kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，油滴了幾滴在車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe them now with a paper towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðɛm naʊ wɪð ə ˈpeɪpər ˈtaʊəl./
dialogue.zh: 趕緊用餐巾紙擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do they keep paper towels?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ðeɪ kip ˈpeɪpər ˈtaʊəlz?/
dialogue.zh: 餐巾紙放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the shelf beside the air machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə ʃɛlf bɪˈsaɪd ði ɛr məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 在打氣機旁邊的架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That second click surprised me a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsɛkənd klɪk sərˈpraɪzd mi ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 第二聲咔噠嚇了我一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The handle always jumps when it quits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈhændəl ˈɔlweɪz dʒʌmps wɛn ɪt kwɪts./
dialogue.zh: 停的時候把手總會彈開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it truly full now or not?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈtruli fʊl naʊ ɔr nɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 現在到底加滿了沒有？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The numbers stopped, so you are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnʌmbərz stɑpt, soʊ ju ɑr dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 數字不動了，就是加好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I used forty two dollars and change.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ juzd ˈfɔrti tu ˈdɑlərz ænd tʃeɪndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 加了四十二塊出頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, that should last two weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, ðæt ʃʊd læst tu wikz./
dialogue.zh: 不錯，夠跑兩個星期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I split gas between two cards?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ splɪt ɡæs bɪˈtwin tu kɑrdz?/
dialogue.zh: 油錢能拆給兩張卡付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, stop the pump and start again.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, stɑp ðə pʌmp ænd stɑrt əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 可以，先停機器再重新來一筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please hold the handle for one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz hoʊld ðə ˈhændəl fər wʌn ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 請幫我握一下把手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I am keeping it open now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, aɪ æm ˈkipɪŋ ɪt ˈoʊpən naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我幫你壓著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, my hand was getting so tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, maɪ hænd wʌz ˈɡɛtɪŋ soʊ ˈtaɪərd./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我的手都酸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest a bit, then take it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ə bɪt, ðɛn teɪk ɪt bæk./
dialogue.zh: 先歇一會兒，再換你拿著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The nozzle is dripping a little now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnoʊzəl ɪz ˈdrɪpɪŋ ə ˈlɪtəl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 油槍現在在滴油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it drip back inside the hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt drɪp bæk ɪnˈsaɪd ðə hoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 讓它滴回加油口裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I count ten before pulling out?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kaʊnt tɛn bɪˈfɔr ˈpʊlɪŋ aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 拔出來之前要不要數十下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that catches the last slow drops.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt ˈkætʃəz ðə læst sloʊ drɑps./
dialogue.zh: 要，等最後幾滴滴乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I am lifting the nozzle out.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ æm ˈlɪftɪŋ ðə ˈnoʊzəl aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 好，我把油槍提出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the handle sits flat and safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈhændəl sɪts flæt ænd seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 看看把手有沒有平放好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I hang the nozzle back up.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ hæŋ ðə ˈnoʊzəl bæk ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 現在我把油槍掛回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I can hang the nozzle back up.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ kæn hæŋ ðə ˈnoʊzəl bæk ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在我可以把油槍掛回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all the nozzles the same shape?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ɔl ðə ˈnoʊzəlz ðə seɪm ʃeɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 所有的油槍形狀都一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, diesel uses the big black one.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈdizəl ˈjuzəz ðə bɪɡ blæk wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 不一樣，柴油槍是黑色大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am screwing the cap back on.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈskruɪŋ ðə kæp bæk ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 我正在把油箱蓋擰回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it right until it clicks twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt raɪt ʌnˈtɪl ɪt klɪks twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 往右擰到響兩聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I heard two clicks, is that good?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd tu klɪks, ɪz ðæt ɡʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 我聽到兩聲咔噠，夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that means it is tight now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt minz ɪt ɪz taɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 夠了，那就表示擰緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I lose the gas cap?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ luz ðə ɡæs kæp?/
dialogue.zh: 要是把油箱蓋弄丟了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The counter sells cheap caps like these.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkaʊntər sɛlz tʃip kæps laɪk ðiz./
dialogue.zh: 櫃台有賣這種便宜的蓋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can a loose cap trip a warning?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ə lus kæp trɪp ə ˈwɔrnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 蓋子沒擰緊會報故障嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the check engine light may glow.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə tʃɛk ˈɛndʒən laɪt meɪ ɡloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 會，引擎檢查燈可能亮起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the little door shut and done?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈlɪtəl dɔr ʃʌt ænd dʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 小門關好了就沒事了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, an open door flaps in wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, æn ˈoʊpən dɔr flæps ɪn wɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 對，敞著會被風吹得啪啪響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wiped my fingers on my shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ waɪpt maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz ɑn maɪ ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 我剛在衣服上擦了手指。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hope it was not an oily spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊp ɪt wʌz nɑt ɑn ˈɔɪli spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 希望沒擦上一片油漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much gas did that put in?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɡæs dɪd ðæt pʊt ɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 那樣一共加進去多少油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Near thirteen gallons, the screen just told us.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɪr θɜrˈtin ˈɡælənz, ðə skrin dʒʌst toʊd ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 快十三加侖，螢幕上剛剛顯示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tank holds about sixteen gallons.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tæŋk hoʊldz əˈbaʊt ˈsɪksˈtin ˈɡælənz./
dialogue.zh: 我的油箱大約裝十六加侖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you filled almost to the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju fɪld ˈɔlmoʊst tə ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 那你幾乎加到頂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the screen shows my total.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə skrin ʃoʊz maɪ ˈtoʊtəl./
dialogue.zh: 現在螢幕顯示我的總金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Remember it before the numbers clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbər ɪt bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈnʌmbərz klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 數字清空前先記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want more of anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt mɔr ʌv ˈɛniˌθɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 你還想要別的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we are ready for the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, wi ɑr ˈrɛdi fər ðə roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 不用，我們可以上路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This sign says no smoking nearby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs saɪn sɛz noʊ ˈsmoʊkɪŋ ˌnɪrˈbaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這個牌子寫著附近禁止吸菸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People still ignore it all the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl stɪl ˌɪɡˈnɔr ɪt ɔl ðə taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 可還是有人完全不理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A man smoked right by pump four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mæn smod raɪt baɪ pʌmp fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有個人就在四號機旁邊抽菸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clerk quickly asked him to stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɜrk ˈkwɪkli æskt hɪm tə stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 店員馬上過去請他熄掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a funnel for this?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ə ˈfʌnəl fər ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 這個要用漏斗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the nozzle fits your tank well.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə ˈnoʊzəl fɪts jʊr tæŋk wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 不用，油槍剛好插得進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My gas door still will not close.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɡæs dɔr stɪl wɪl nɑt kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 我的加油門還是關不上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sticks when weather turns cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɪks wɛn ˈwɛðər tɜrnz koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 天氣一冷它就卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is freezing, my fingers hurt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈfrizɪŋ, maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz hɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 天好冷，我手指都凍疼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pumping gas is tough in the chill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʌmpɪŋ ɡæs ɪz tʌf ɪn ðə tʃɪl./
dialogue.zh: 大冷天加油真是苦差事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Man, the warm store sounds so much better.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæn, ðə wɔrm stɔr saʊndz soʊ mʌtʃ ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 天啊，暖和的商店聽起來好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finish up and go pay in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪnɪʃ ʌp ænd ɡoʊ peɪ ɪn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 收拾好就進去付錢吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that pump print a receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðæt pʌmp prɪnt ə rɪˈsit?/
dialogue.zh: 那台機子會印收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the store prints it out inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə stɔr prɪnts ɪt aʊt ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 不會，收據要進店裡才印得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the screen says thank you now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ðə skrin sɛz ˈθæŋk ju naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕現在顯示謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means your sale is complete.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz jʊr seɪl ɪz kəmˈplit./
dialogue.zh: 那就表示這單結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, the numbers stopped at forty two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr, ðə ˈnʌmbərz stɑpt æt ˈfɔrti tu./
dialogue.zh: 你看，數字停在四十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty two fifty, close to my guess.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tu ˈfɪfti, kloʊs tə maɪ ɡɛs./
dialogue.zh: 四十二塊五，跟我猜的差不多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I always feel poor at the pump.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlweɪz fil pʊr æt ðə pʌmp./
dialogue.zh: 每次加油我都覺得錢包在哭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, gas is never cheap.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm hɪr, ɡæs ɪz ˈnɛvər tʃip./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，油價從來沒便宜過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us keep the tank half full.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs kip ðə tæŋk hæf fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 我們以後保持半箱油吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That protects the pump from burning out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt prəˈtɛkts ðə pʌmp frʌm ˈbɜrnɪŋ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 那樣能保護油泵不燒壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good job, the cap is on tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd dʒɑb, ðə kæp ɪz ɑn taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 幹得好，蓋子擰得很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Door closed too, let us walk inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɔr kloʊzd tu, lɛt ʌs wɔk ˈɪnsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 小門也關了，我們進店裡去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that pump give short gallons?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðæt pʌmp ɡɪv ʃɔrt ˈɡælənz?/
dialogue.zh: 那台機子有沒有少給油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they test the pumps each year.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðeɪ tɛst ðə pʌmps itʃ jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，機器每年都會受檢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I trust the numbers on this screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ trʌst ðə ˈnʌmbərz ɑn ðɪs skrin./
dialogue.zh: 我信這塊屏上的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They must keep pumps honest by law.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ məst kip pʌmps ˈɑnəst baɪ lɔ./
dialogue.zh: 法律要求他們不能短斤少兩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready to walk to the store door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi tə wɔk tə ðə stɔr dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 準備好走向店裡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, grab the keys and let us go.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɡræb ðə kiz ænd lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好了，拿上車鑰匙走吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the store door is still open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðə stɔr dɔr ɪz stɪl ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，商店門還開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the door chime still works too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə dɔr tʃaɪm stɪl wɜrks tu./
dialogue.zh: 對，門鈴也還在響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for gas in here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ fər ɡæs ɪn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 油費是在裡面付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tell the clerk your pump number.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tɛl ðə klɜrk jʊr pʌmp ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 對，告訴店員你是幾號機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pump twelve, that is forty two fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʌmp twɛlv, ðæt ɪz ˈfɔrti tu ˈfɪfti./
dialogue.zh: 十二號機，一共四十二塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cash or card, the register is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ ɔr kɑrd, ðə ˈrɛdʒəstər ɪz ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 現金還是卡？收銀機準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will pay with my debit card.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl peɪ wɪð maɪ ˈdɛbət kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 我用簽帳金融卡付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Insert it and type your four digit code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsɜrt ɪt ænd taɪp jʊr fɔr ˈdɪdʒət koʊd./
dialogue.zh: 插卡，再輸入四位密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, the card reader beeped twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən, ðə kɑrd ˈridər bipt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 聽，讀卡器剛剛滴了兩聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the payment went through.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ðə ˈpeɪmənt wɛnt θru./
dialogue.zh: 那就代表付款成功了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, I typed my old pin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps, aɪ taɪpt maɪ oʊld pɪn./
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，我輸的是舊的密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try once more, you have two guesses.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ wʌns mɔr, ju hæv tu ˈɡɛsəz./
dialogue.zh: 再試一次，你還有兩次機會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card keeps getting declined here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd kips ˈɡɛtɪŋ dɪˈklaɪnd hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我的卡在這裡老是刷不過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should call your bank today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ʃʊd kɔl jʊr bæŋk təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 你今天該打電話問銀行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I split the bill in half?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ splɪt ðə bɪl ɪn hæf?/
dialogue.zh: 這筆錢可以分兩半付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, half card and half cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, hæf kɑrd ænd hæf kæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 當然，一半刷卡一半現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take phone payments here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju teɪk foʊn ˈpeɪmənts hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡可以用手機付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap your phone on the reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tæp jʊr foʊn ɑn ðə ˈridər./
dialogue.zh: 可以，手機往感應區一貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you print receipts here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju prɪnt rɪˈsɪts hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡會印收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, it printed already.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ju ɡoʊ, ɪt ˈprɪntəd ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 給您，已經印好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I paid at the pump, is that fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ peɪd æt ðə pʌmp, ɪz ðæt faɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我在機器那邊付過了，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep the small printed slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, kip ðə smɔl ˈprɪntəd slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 可以，留好那張小收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the machine ate my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, ðə məˈʃin et maɪ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，機器把我的卡吞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait here, a clerk will bring it.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt hɪr, ə klɜrk wɪl brɪŋ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 稍等，店員會幫您取回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for saving my credit card.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fər ˈseɪvɪŋ maɪ ˈkrɛdɪt kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你們幫我把卡拿回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, watch the reader next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm, wɑtʃ ðə ˈridər nɛkst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，下次留意讀卡機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you offer a rewards program?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈɔfər ə rɪˈwɔrdz ˈproʊɡræm?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有會員回饋計畫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten cents off every gallon.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tɛn sɛnts ɔf ˈɛvri ˈɡælən./
dialogue.zh: 有，每加侖折十美分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it free to join the club?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt fri tə dʒɔɪn ðə klʌb?/
dialogue.zh: 加入會員要錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free, just fill this short form out.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri, dʒʌst fɪl ðɪs ʃɔrt fɔrm aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 免費，填一下這張短表就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks for my name and phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æsks fər maɪ neɪm ænd foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 表上要我的名字和電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They text you gas deals on Fridays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ tɛkst ju ɡæs dilz ɑn ˈfraɪdeɪz./
dialogue.zh: 週五他們會傳折扣給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I scan my card at the pump?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ skæn maɪ kɑrd æt ðə pʌmp?/
dialogue.zh: 我的會員卡要在機器上掃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, press rewards first, then swipe it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, prɛs rɪˈwɔrdz fɜrst, ðɛn swaɪp ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，先按會員積分鍵，再刷卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved about a dollar today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪvd əˈbaʊt ə ˈdɑlər təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我今天省了大約一塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That adds up over a whole year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈædz ʌp ˈoʊvər ə hoʊl jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 一整年下來就很多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the club have a coffee deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə klʌb hæv ə ˈkɔfi dil?/
dialogue.zh: 會員有咖啡優惠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, free refill with any gas buy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, fri ˈrifɪl wɪð ˈɛni ɡæs baɪ./
dialogue.zh: 有，加油就能免費續杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One large coffee, black, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn lɑrdʒ ˈkɔfi, blæk, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請給我一杯大杯黑咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is one dollar with your card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz wʌn ˈdɑlər wɪð jʊr kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 用會員卡只要一塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a lid for this cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə lɪd fər ðɪs kʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 這杯可以給我個蓋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lids sit right by the syrup machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪdz sɪt raɪt baɪ ðə ˈsɪrəp məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 杯蓋就擱在糖漿機旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the coffee fresh right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈkɔfi frɛʃ raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 現在的咖啡是新煮的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They brewed a pot an hour ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ brud ə pɑt ən aʊər əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 一小時前剛煮好一壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want a snack from the aisle?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ə snæk frʌm ðə aɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 你想從貨架拿點零食嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the chips, the cheap two dollar bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt ðə tʃɪps, ðə tʃip tu ˈdɑlər bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 買洋芋片吧，兩塊一包的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, the cooler has cold water inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ, ðə ˈkulər hæz koʊld ˈwɔtər ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 嘿，冷藏櫃裡有冰水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab two bottles, the road is long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræb tu ˈbɑtəlz, ðə roʊd ɪz lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 拿兩瓶，長途要喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the restroom in this store?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈrʊmˌtum ɪn ðɪs stɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 這家店的洗手間在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back left, the key hangs at the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk lɛft, ðə ki hæz æt ðə ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 左後方，鑰匙掛在櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the restroom need a key?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðə ˈrʊmˌtum nid ə ki?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼洗手間要拿鑰匙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the door stays locked for safety.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə dɔr steɪz lɑkt fər ˈseɪfti./
dialogue.zh: 為了安全，門平時鎖著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gee, this key ring is huge.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒi, ðɪs ki rɪŋ ɪz hjudʒ./
dialogue.zh: 咦，這鑰匙圈也太大了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, big keys are hard to lose.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bɪɡ kiz ɑr hɑrd tə luz./
dialogue.zh: 對，鑰匙大就不怕弄丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will be one quick minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl bi wʌn kwɪk ˈmɪnət./
dialogue.zh: 我很快就回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take time, I will wait with the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk taɪm, aɪ wɪl weɪt wɪð ðə kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，我在車邊等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which pump was it, twelve or eight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ pʌmp wʌz ɪt, twɛlv ɔr eɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 到底是幾號機來著，十二還是八？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pump twelve, it is on the receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʌmp twɛlv, ɪt ɪz ɑn ðə rɪˈsit./
dialogue.zh: 十二號機，收據小票上寫著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, the clerk says seven fifty total.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, ðə klɜrk sɛz ˈsɛvən ˈfɪfti ˈtoʊtəl./
dialogue.zh: 店員說我們總共七塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven fifty? How did we hit that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ˈfɪfti? haʊ dɪd wi hɪt ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 七塊五？怎麼算到這個數的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee, two chip bags, water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi, tu tʃɪp bæɡz, ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 咖啡、兩包洋芋片，還有水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh right, small things get expensive.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt, smɔl θɪŋz ɡɛt ɪkˈspɛnsɪv./
dialogue.zh: 哦對，小東西也不便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I return this wrong magazine?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rɪˈtɜrn ðɪs rɔŋ ˌmæɡəˈzin?/
dialogue.zh: 這本雜誌拿錯了能退嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only with the receipt, within ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɪð ðə rɪˈsit, wɪˈðɪn tɛn ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 要憑收據，十分鐘內才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell air fresheners here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl ɛr ˈfrɛʃənərz hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你們賣車載芳香劑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, by the register, one ninety nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, baɪ ðə ˈrɛdʒəstər, wʌn ˈnaɪnti naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 有，收銀台旁，一塊九九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These pine trees smell too fake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz paɪn triz smɛl tu feɪk./
dialogue.zh: 這些松樹造型味道好假。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick the vanilla one, it is nicer.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ðə vəˈnɪlə wʌn, ɪt ɪz ˈnaɪsər./
dialogue.zh: 挑香草味的，那個比較好聞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This store has clean tables outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs stɔr hæz klin ˈteɪbəlz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 店外面有乾淨的桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People sit there and wait for rides.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl sɪt ðɛr ænd weɪt fər raɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 大家坐那兒等人來接。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A delivery truck is at the back door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dɪˈlɪvəri trʌk ɪz æt ðə bæk dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有送貨車停在後門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They restock the cooler every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈriːstɑk ðə ˈkulər ˈɛvri naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 他們每晚都會補貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Truly, the clerk here is always friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtruli, ðə klɜrk hɪr ɪz ˈɔlweɪz ˈfrɛndli./
dialogue.zh: 說真的，這裡的店員總是很親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this station feels like family.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɪs ˈsteɪʃən filz laɪk ˈfæməli./
dialogue.zh: 對，這家站像家人一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use the bathroom before we go?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juz ðə ˈbæθˌrum bɪˈfɔr wi ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 走之前我可以用洗手間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the key is right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ðə ki ɪz raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 當然，鑰匙就在這兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take coins for candy?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju teɪk kɔɪnz fər ˈkændi?/
dialogue.zh: 買糖果可以付硬幣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the coin jar by the door works.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə kɔɪn dʒɑr baɪ ðə dɔr wɜrks./
dialogue.zh: 可以，丟進門邊的零錢罐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My daughter wants a gummy bear bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdɔtər wɑnts ə ˈɡʌmi bɛr bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我女兒想買一袋小熊軟糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the small one, not the giant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt ðə smɔl wʌn, nɑt ðə ˈdʒaɪənt./
dialogue.zh: 拿小包的，別拿超大包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this sandwich still good to eat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈsænwɪtʃ stɪl ɡʊd tə it?/
dialogue.zh: 這三明治還能吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the date on the wrapper flap.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə deɪt ɑn ðə ˈræpər flæp./
dialogue.zh: 看看包裝蓋上的日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says best before tomorrow noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz bɛst bɪˈfɔr təˈmɑroʊ nun./
dialogue.zh: 上面寫著明天中午前食用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it is fine for our lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt ɪz faɪn fər ˈaʊər lʌntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們午餐吃沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aha, the microwave in the corner works.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈhɑ, ðə ˈmaɪkroʊˌweɪv ɪn ðə ˈkɔrnər wɜrks./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，角落的微波爐是能用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heat it two minutes, turn it once.
dialogue.phonetic: /hit ɪt tu ˈmɪnəts, tɜrn ɪt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 加熱兩分鐘，中間翻個面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They sell stamps at this counter, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ sɛl stæmps æt ðɪs ˈkaʊntər, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這個櫃台有賣郵票，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, try the post office downtown.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, traɪ ðə poʊst ˈɔfəs ˈdaʊntɑn./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，去市區的郵局看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy a phone charger here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ baɪ ə foʊn ˈtʃɑrdʒər hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這裡買手機充電器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cheap ones hang near the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tʃip wʌnz hæŋ nɪr ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，門邊掛著便宜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one charges too slow for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ˈtʃɑrdʒɪz tu sloʊ fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 這個充電太慢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy the fast one, it is worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə fæst wʌn, ɪt ɪz wɜrθ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 買快充那款，值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, paper bags cost extra money here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ˈpeɪpər bæɡz kɔst ˈɛkstrə ˈmʌni hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 唉，紙袋要另外收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten cents, or carry it in your hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn sɛnts, ɔr ˈkæri ɪt ɪn jʊr hændz./
dialogue.zh: 一毛錢，或你直接用手拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy a gift card too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ baɪ ə ɡɪft kɑrd tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我也可以順便買張禮品卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, from ten to a hundred dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, frʌm tɛn tə ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 有，十塊到一百塊都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to sign this slip?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə saɪn ðɪs slɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要在這張小票上簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, press done and you are set.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, prɛs dʌn ænd ju ɑr sɛt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，按完成就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paid in full, we can move on.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪd ɪn fʊl, wi kæn muv ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 全部付好了，我們可以走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a safe drive, come back soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə seɪf draɪv, kʌm bæk sun./
dialogue.zh: 開車小心，歡迎再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my tire light on the dash?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ ˈtaɪər laɪt ɑn ðə dæʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 儀表板上輪胎燈亮了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that means low tire pressure.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt minz loʊ ˈtaɪər ˈprɛʃər./
dialogue.zh: 對，那是胎壓不足的警告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the free air machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ði fri ɛr məˈʃin?/
dialogue.zh: 免費打氣機在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Past pump ten, near the tall pole.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst pʌmp tɛn, nɪr ðə tɔl poʊl./
dialogue.zh: 過了十號機，靠近高杆那兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I use this air hose?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ juz ðɪs ɛr hoʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 這條氣管要怎麼用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the air tip on the valve stem.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ði ɛr tɪp ɑn ðə vælv stɛm./
dialogue.zh: 把氣槍頭按緊在氣門嘴上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It hisses when the air comes out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhɪsɪz wɛn ði ɛr kʌmz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 出氣的時候會有嘶嘶聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is normal, hold the hose straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈnɔrməl, hoʊld ðə hoʊz streɪt./
dialogue.zh: 很正常，把管子扶直就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What number should my tires show?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈnʌmbər ʃʊd maɪ ˈtaɪərz ʃoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 胎壓該打到多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty two psi, see the door sticker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrdi tu ˌpiːɛsˈaɪ, si ðə dɔr ˈstɪkər./
dialogue.zh: 三十二 PSI，看車門貼紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine does not match your card total.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn dʌz nɑt mætʃ jʊr kɑrd ˈtoʊtəl./
dialogue.zh: 我的數跟你卡上的總額對不上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your owner book lists the right number.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈoʊnər bʊk lɪsts ðə raɪt ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 車主手冊裡寫了正確數值。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One tire looks flatter than the others.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈtaɪər lʊks ˈflætər ðən ði ˈʌðərz./
dialogue.zh: 有一條輪胎看起來特別扁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill that one first and check again.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl ðæt wʌn fɜrst ænd tʃɛk əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 先幫那條打滿再複查一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the gauge here reads way off.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm, ðə ɡeɪdʒ hɪr ridz weɪ ˈɔf./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這裡的胎壓表讀數不太對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the pen gauge in your glove box.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə pɛn ɡeɪdʒ ɪn jʊr ɡlʌv bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 用手套箱裡那支筆式量壓表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, I put too much air in now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps, aɪ pʊt tu mʌtʃ ɛr ɪn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，我打太多氣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the center pin to let some out.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə ˈsɛntər pɪn tə lɛt sʌm aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 按一下中間的小針就能放氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, the tire feels firm again.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, ðə ˈtaɪər filz fɜrm əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，輪胎又變飽滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the spare tire once a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə spɛr ˈtaɪər wʌns ə mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 備胎也要一個月檢查一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this station sell tire shine?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs ˈsteɪʃən sɛl ˈtaɪər ʃaɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 這家站賣輪胎亮油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the black bottle on shelf three.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə blæk ˈbɑtəl ɑn ʃɛlf θri./
dialogue.zh: 有，第三排那瓶黑色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I check my oil right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tʃɛk maɪ ɔɪl raɪt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我能在這兒檢查機油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pull the yellow ring under the hood.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, pʊl ðə ˈjɛloʊ rɪŋ ˈʌndər ðə hʊd./
dialogue.zh: 可以，拉引擎蓋下那個黃環。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Geez, the oil level looks a bit low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡiz, ðə ɔɪl ˈlɛvəl lʊks ə bɪt loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，機油量看起來有點低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy a quart of oil at the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ə kwɔrt ʌv ɔɪl æt ðə ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 去櫃台買一誇脫機油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they have the right oil here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ hæv ðə raɪt ɔɪl hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有對號的機油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, read the label before you pour.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, rid ðə ˈleɪbəl bɪˈfɔr ju pɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有，倒之前先看一下標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the washer fluid on that rack?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɑʃər ˈfluɪd ɑn ðæt ræk?/
dialogue.zh: 玻璃水在那個架子上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue jug, the summer kind is on sale.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu dʒʌɡ, ðə ˈsʌmər kaɪnd ɪz ɑn seɪl./
dialogue.zh: 藍壺的，夏季款正在特價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My winter spray freezes on the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈwɪntər spreɪ ˈfrizəz ɑn ðə ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 我用的噴液在玻璃上結冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy the minus twenty bottle instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə ˈmaɪnəs ˈtwɛnti ˈbɑtəl ɪnˈstɛd./
dialogue.zh: 那就買耐零下二十度那瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the washer fluid go?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə ˈwɑʃər ˈfluɪd ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 玻璃水應該倒進哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cap with the windshield picture.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæp wɪð ðə ˈwɪndʃiˌænd ˈpɪktʃər./
dialogue.zh: 印著擋風玻璃圖樣的蓋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I poured it in the wrong hole!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pɔrd ɪt ɪn ðə rɔŋ hoʊl!/
dialogue.zh: 我倒進錯的口了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which hole? The oil or the coolant?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ hoʊl? ði ɔɪl ɔr ði ˈkulənt?/
dialogue.zh: 哪個口？機油還是冷卻液？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bad news, the coolant tank is pink.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæd nuz, ðə ˈkulənt tæŋk ɪz pɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 不好了，冷卻液壺變成粉紅色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not drive, call the tow truck line.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt draɪv, kɔl ðə taʊ trʌk laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 別開車，打拖車電話來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my friend's car will not start.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ maɪ frɛndz kɑr wɪl nɑt stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 現在我朋友的車也發不動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the cables are in my back seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ðə ˈkeɪbəlz ɑr ɪn maɪ bæk sit./
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，過橋線在我的後座。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its battery is dead, the engine clicks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈbætəri ɪz dɛd, ði ˈɛndʒən klɪks./
dialogue.zh: 它的電池沒電了，引擎喀喀響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us connect the clamps step by step.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs kəˈnɛkt ðə kæmps stɛp baɪ stɛp./
dialogue.zh: 我們一步一步夾上線夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its lights are dim too, what could it be?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts laɪts ɑr dɪm tu, wɑt kʊd ɪt bi?/
dialogue.zh: 車燈也好暗，會是什麼問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Could be, get the alternator checked there.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd bi, ɡɛt ði ɔlˈtɜrnəˌteɪtər tʃɛkt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 有可能，去檢查發電機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That man got diesel in his car!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt mæn ɡɑt ˈdizəl ɪn hɪz kɑr!/
dialogue.zh: 那個人的車被加到柴油了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Poor guy, he must not start the engine.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊr ɡaɪ, hi məst nɑt stɑrt ði ˈɛndʒən./
dialogue.zh: 可憐，他千萬別發動引擎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He just handed the clerk his keys.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi dʒʌst ˈhændəd ðə klɜrk hɪz kiz./
dialogue.zh: 他直接把鑰匙交給了店員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrong fuel can wreck the whole engine.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɔŋ ˈfjuəl kæn rɛk ðə hoʊl ˈɛndʒən./
dialogue.zh: 加錯油會整個毀掉引擎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will his insurance cover a mistake?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl hɪz ɪnˈʃʊrəns ˈkʌvər ə mɪsˈteɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 他的保險會賠這種疏失嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The station pays, the receipt is proof.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsteɪʃən peɪz, ðə rɪˈsit ɪz pruf./
dialogue.zh: 加油站會賠，收據就是憑證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They must drain the tank at the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ məst dreɪn ðə tæŋk æt ðə ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 修車廠得先把油箱抽乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That takes an hour and costs real money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt teɪks ən ˈaʊər ænd kɔsts riəl ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 那要一小時，也很花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their manager said sorry and paid it all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ˈmænɪdʒər sɛd ˈsɑri ænd peɪd ɪt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 他們經理道了歉，費用全包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They covered the drain and the whole tow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈkʌvərd ðə dreɪn ænd ðə hoʊl taʊ./
dialogue.zh: 抽油和拖車的錢都是他們付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long did the poor man wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dɪd ðə pʊr mæn weɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 那個人等了多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It took all morning, eight to eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tʊk ɔl ˈmɔrnɪŋ, eɪt tə ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 花了整個上午，八點到十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the station drive him to the shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈsteɪʃən draɪv hɪm tə ðə ʃɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 加油站有載他去修車廠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one clerk took him for free.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn klɜrk tʊk hɪm fər fri./
dialogue.zh: 有，一位店員免費送他去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, the pump took my cash and froze.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ, ðə pʌmp tʊk maɪ kæʃ ænd froʊz./
dialogue.zh: 嘿，加油機收了錢卻卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That happens, we will refund you right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈhæpənz, wi wɪl rɪˈfʌnd ju raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這狀況常有，我們立刻退費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please check the camera for pump nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz tʃɛk ðə ˈkæmərə fər pʌmp naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 請調九號機的監控看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, our video shows your card did fail.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈaʊər ˈvɪdioʊ ʃoʊz jʊr kɑrd dɪd feɪl./
dialogue.zh: 影片顯示您的刷卡確實失敗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My screen froze at the pay step.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ skrin froʊz æt ðə peɪ stɛp./
dialogue.zh: 我的螢幕付錢那步卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the orange button to call help.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ði ˈɔrɪndʒ ˈbɑtən tə kɔl hɛlp./
dialogue.zh: 按橘色按鈕就能叫人來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A voice came through the little speaker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə vɔɪs keɪm θru ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈspikər./
dialogue.zh: 小喇叭裡傳出一個聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say your pump and tell them the trouble.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ jʊr pʌmp ænd tɛl ðɛm ðə ˈtrʌbəl./
dialogue.zh: 說出機號，再講發生了什麼事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only two minutes later, help arrived.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tu ˈmɪnɪts ˈleɪtər, hɛlp əˈraɪvd./
dialogue.zh: 才兩分鐘，服務人員就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is faster than most stations are.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈfæstər ðən moʊst ˈsteɪʃənz ɑr./
dialogue.zh: 比多數加油站快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He reset the pump with a key card.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi riˈsɛt ðə pʌmp wɪð ə ki kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 他用管理卡把機器重設。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now try your card again, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ traɪ jʊr kɑrd əˈɡɛn, ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 現在請慢慢再刷一次卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This time the screen lit up green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs taɪm ðə skrin lɪt ʌp ɡrin./
dialogue.zh: 這次螢幕亮成綠色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, your gas is on the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, jʊr ɡæs ɪz ɑn ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，油馬上就來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I spilled some gas on the ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ spɪld sʌm ɡæs ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 我把一些油灑在地上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell the clerk, they keep sawdust here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðə klɜrk, ðeɪ kip ˈsɔˌdʌst hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 跟店員說，這裡有木屑可清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a spill hurt the pavement?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ə spɪl hɜrt ðə ˈpeɪvmənt?/
dialogue.zh: 灑在地上的油會傷路面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They clean it fast for safety rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ klin ɪt fæst fər ˈseɪfti rulz./
dialogue.zh: 依安全規定要立刻清掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the trash bin at pump one is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə træʃ bɪn æt pʌmp wʌn ɪz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 你看，一號機旁的垃圾桶滿出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will mention it to the kind clerk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈmɛnʃən ɪt tə ðə kaɪnd klɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 我會跟那位好心的店員說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is broken glass near the air pump.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ˈbroʊkən ɡlæs nɪr ði ɛr pʌmp./
dialogue.zh: 打氣機附近有碎玻璃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please stay away, we will sweep it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz steɪ əˈweɪ, wi wɪl swip ɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 請遠離，我們馬上掃乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My price was higher than the sign said.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ praɪs wʌz ˈhaɪər ðən ðə saɪn sɛd./
dialogue.zh: 收我的價錢比牌子上的高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show them your photo of the sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ ðɛm jʊr ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv ðə saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 把您拍的價牌照片給他們看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the end, the manager fixed my price.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ði ɛnd, ðə ˈmænɪdʒər fɪkst maɪ praɪs./
dialogue.zh: 最後經理把我的單價調降了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Signs must match, that is the law.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪnz məst mætʃ, ðæt ɪz ðə lɔ./
dialogue.zh: 價牌必須一致，這是法令。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I complain online about this?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kəmˈpleɪn ˌɑnˈlaɪn əˈbaʊt ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在線上投訴這件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there is a survey on your receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛr ɪz ə ˈsɜrveɪ ɑn jʊr rɪˈsit./
dialogue.zh: 可以，收據上就有問卷網址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only want a fair answer today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊnli wɑnt ə fɛr ˈænsər təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我今天只想要個公平的答覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have it, we will mail you a coupon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv ɪt, wi wɪl meɪl ju ə ˈkupɑn./
dialogue.zh: 您會得到，我們寄折價券給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, the wiper blades need changing soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ, ðə ˈwaɪpər bleɪdz nid ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ sun./
dialogue.zh: 還有，雨刷很快就要換了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They hang by the register in packs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ hæŋ baɪ ðə ˈrɛdʒəstər ɪn pæks./
dialogue.zh: 收銀旁就掛著成對的雨刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the clerk install them for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə klɜrk ɪnˈstɔl ðɛm fər mi?/
dialogue.zh: 店員可以幫我裝上去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it takes two minutes with no fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt teɪks tu ˈmɪnəts wɪð noʊ fi./
dialogue.zh: 可以，兩分鐘裝好還不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New wipers make the glass so clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ˈwaɪpərz meɪk ðə ɡlæs soʊ klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 新雨刷把玻璃颳得好乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night driving feels safe again now.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ˈdraɪvɪŋ filz seɪf əˈɡɛn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 晚上開車又安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell coolant in yellow jugs?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl ˈkulənt ɪn ˈjɛloʊ dʒʌɡz?/
dialogue.zh: 你們賣黃色壺裝的冷卻液嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, shelf four, next to the washer fluid.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ʃɛlf fɔr, nɛkst tə ðə ˈwɑʃər ˈfluɪd./
dialogue.zh: 有，第四排，玻璃水旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything is checked, tires and fluid too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɪz tʃɛkt, ˈtaɪərz ænd ˈfluɪd tu./
dialogue.zh: 輪胎和油水都檢查過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we are ready for the long road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ɑr ˈrɛdi fər ðə lɔŋ roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 那我們準備好出遠門了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for all your help today.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fər ɔl jʊr hɛlp təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你今天所有的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive safe, and enjoy the open road.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪv seɪf, ænd ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ði ˈoʊpən roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 開車小心，享受這段旅程。
